name: ASLN 2600
title: Process of Interpreting: American Sign Language and English
description: Theory and practice of ASL/English interpreting. Models of interpretation including text analysis and the goal of linguistic equivalency. Discourse analysis, visualization, listening and comprehending, shadowing, paraphrasing, abstracting, dual-task training, and cloze skills.
requirement_description: ASLN 1102 or consent of the instructor.
